stops.note: Microwave Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation; Charles Townes and colleagues built the first maser at Columbia University in 1954, on principles Einstein described in 1917

Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation, a term Gordon Gould wrote in his notebook in 1957; Theodore Maiman fired the first working laser at Hughes Research Laboratories in Malibu on 16 May 1960

current_meaning: a device that emits an intense narrow beam of coherent light
